messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "0", "observation": "A siren sounds, followed by a brief musical effect."}, {"id": "15", "observation": "A siren wails, then a car engine revs and accelerates, followed by a sustained, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "45", "observation": "A woman grunts and yells while fighting, accompanied by a sword clashing and a monster roaring."}, {"id": "60", "observation": "A loud, sustained musical chord plays, followed by a high-pitched scream, a heavy thud, and a person's heavy breathing."}, {"id": "75", "observation": "A car engine starts, idles, and accelerates, with a brief high-pitched squeal and a sustained electronic tone."}, {"id": "105", "observation": "The non-speech sounds include a steady, low-frequency hum and intermittent metallic clinks."}, {"id": "120", "observation": "The non-speech sounds include a low-frequency hum, a high-pitched electronic whine, and intermittent rustling noises."}, {"id": "135", "observation": "The non-speech sounds include a soft sigh, a sharp click, and a series of metallic clinks."}]
